claims.statement: Peripheral delivery, central arrival, aggregate consumer update and matched output do not identify actual read by a named consumer while an alternative writer is uncontrolled.
claims.domain: The eight-row Boolean mechanism S,G,X with U=(S AND G) OR X.
all_premises: alternative writer X may be active
claims.counterexamples: S=1,X=1,G=0 and S=1,X=1,G=1 have the same ordinary evidence.
claims.thought_experiment_role: Redundant-writer twin varies read while fixing delivery, arrival and output.

claims.statement: With S=1 and X=0, G is identified by U only if the stipulated interface, selectivity, sole-writer, timing and faithful-readout premises hold.
claims.domain: Exclusive-probe rows with delivered selected carrier.
claims.counterexamples: Any hidden writer, off-target effect, consumer mismatch or unfaithful readout defeats the inference.
claims.thought_experiment_role: Exclusive probe states the minimum condition that defeats the redundant-writer twin.

claims.statement: A genuine read-versus-no-read contrast necessarily changes the selected consumer-carrier relation even if a declared distal envelope is matched; other biological co-changes are not entailed by the finite logic.
claims.domain: Same declared episode contract and partial distal-output match.
all_premises: complete organization includes the selected relation
claims.counterexamples: A compensating hypothetical device can hold effort, EMG or attention fixed while G changes, so those changes are not logical consequences.
claims.thought_experiment_role: Matched-output exoskeleton separates partial consequence equality from organizational equality.

claims.statement: The inspected primary studies establish components of the two-level package but not a complete same-episode selective consumer-read installation.
claims.counterexamples: An uninspected or future integrated experiment may satisfy the contract.
claims.thought_experiment_role: Closest regimes show which coordinate remains unverified.
